description: This Go source file defines interfaces, structs, and functions for accessing and managing webhook configurations in Kubernetes, including mutating and validating webhooks, with methods for retrieving webhook details, selectors, clients, and match conditions.

classes.name: mutatingWebhookAccessor
classes.description: Struct implementing WebhookAccessor for mutating webhooks, managing webhook details, selectors, client, and match conditions.

classes.name: validatingWebhookAccessor
classes.description: Struct implementing WebhookAccessor for validating webhooks, managing webhook details, selectors, client, and match conditions.

methods.name: GetUID
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the webhook.

methods.name: GetConfigurationName
methods.description: Returns the name of the webhook configuration.

methods.name: GetRESTClient
methods.description: Retrieves the REST client for the webhook, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: GetType
methods.description: Returns the type of webhook ('admit' or 'validate').

methods.name: GetCompiledMatcher
methods.description: Returns the compiled matcher for webhook match conditions.

methods.name: GetParsedNamespaceSelector
methods.description: Parses and returns the namespace selector.

methods.name: GetParsedObjectSelector
methods.description: Parses and returns the object selector.

methods.name: GetFailurePolicy
methods.description: Returns the failure policy of the webhook.

methods.name: GetMatchPolicy
methods.description: Returns the match policy of the webhook.

methods.name: GetTimeoutSeconds
methods.description: Returns the timeout seconds for the webhook.

methods.name: GetAdmissionReviewVersions
methods.description: Returns the admission review versions supported.
